meta.title: The bidding-summary rank filter only offers sensible limits
gaps: Verify that the Bidding Summary panel refreshes automatically every 30 seconds.
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`
can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the Bidding Summary panel refreshes automatically every 30 seconds.

steps.note: Open an existing auction event suitable for inspecting the bidding summary.
Open the Bidding Summary panel from the event details page.
Assert that the rank filter offers exactly Top 1 Vendors, Top 2 Vendors, and All Vendors.
Choose All Vendors to verify the unbounded-rank request behavior.
Assert that the refresh request after choosing All Vendors does not include a rank_limit query parameter.
